subject: [PATCH pynfs 2/6] server41tests: check that delegated times survive DELEGRETURN

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch adds a test to the server41tests suite in the pynfs project. The test checks that delegated timestamps survive a DELEGRETURN operation, which is used by NFSv4.2 clients to delegate timestamp updates to the server. The test creates a file and gets an OPEN_DELEGATE_WRITE_ATTRS_DELEG delegation, then writes to the file and requires that the server applies the updated mtime and other attributes do not change across the DELEGRETURN operation. If the server does not offer or grant delegated timestamps, the test is skipped.
